# World of Zoth — Complete Technical & Lore Specification (`llms-full.txt`)

- **Repository**: https://github.com/1nc0gn30/world-of-zoth
- **Web Experience**: https://1nc0gn30.si
- **Creator & Attribution**: Engineered by `1nc0gn30` (`@1nc0gn30`) • `NullAI Platform` (`https://nullai.tech`)
- **License & Access**: 100% open-access, free forever, zero paywalls, zero cloud dependencies, zero telemetry.

## 1. Engine & Gameplay Architecture
World of Zoth is a zero-dependency 3D Lattice RPG and procedural WebGL/Canvas universe packed into a self-contained browser runtime (`index.html` + `game.js` / standalone `world-of-zoth.html`) and native Android APK (`dist/world-of-zoth.apk`):
- **20 Playable 3D Lattice Districts**: Relit City (`hub`), Rest Woods (`forest`), The Hollow (`relay`), Fiber Tunnels (`fiber`), Sand Clocktower (`clock`), Collapse Streets (`streets`), Doom-Fire Foundry (`foundry`), Physarum Caves (`caves`), Hall of Mirrors (`mirrors`), Deep-Water Memory (`deep`), Mode-7 Skyline (`skyline`), Sub-Lattice Abyss (`abyss`), Zero-Knowledge Citadel (`citadel`), The Null Core (`nullcore`), Secret Sector — The Rooftop (`rooftop`), The Quantum Loom (`loom`), The Chrono-Vault (`vault`), The Astral Spire (`astral`), The Omega Foundry (`omega`), and The Dawn Horizon (`horizon`).
- **5-Act Narrative (`06:12` -> `06:13` First Dawn)**:
  - Act I: *Faces, Not Voices* (Boss: `03ng0cn1`)
  - Act II: *Chorus* (Boss: `RELAY 4`)
  - Act III: *Inside the Lines* (Boss: `SANDGLASS`)
  - Act IV: *Hall of Superposition* (Boss: `THE HUNTER`)
  - Act V: *06:12 — The Dawn* (Boss: `>_` & Post-Game `ARCHON-0` in Zero-Knowledge Citadel)
- **Null Academy**: 16 interactive AI-Security & cryptography labs embedded directly inside Relit City.
- **Procedural Audio & Cinema**: WebAudio synthesis engine + 36-episode theatrical storyboard commercial showcase (`commercial.html`).
